title: OKF v0.2 Frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter block in headcleaner-emitted OKF v0.2 concept files. Use this in VS Code / IntelliJ YAML schema associations to get autocomplete + validation.

type.description: OKF required field — the concept type. headcleaner always emits 'Document'.

title.description: Human-readable concept title. Required by headcleaner.

resource.description: Primary resource URI (typically file:// path to the source document).

status.description: OKF v0.2 lifecycle status. headcleaner sets 'unverified' on auto-conversion; review can set 'verified' or 'rejected'.

stale_after.description: ISO 8601 date after which this concept is considered stale.

sources.description: Provenance list — at least one entry required.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the source bytes (lowercase, 64 chars).

generated.description: Provenance agent that produced this concept. Format: 'kind:<id>@<host>'. headcleaner sets 'human:<user>@<host>'.

verified.description: Reviewer that signed off on this concept. 'human:pending' is the default after auto-conversion; reviewer tools set this.

source.description: Obsidian-compat flat field — equal to sources[0].uri.

sha256.description: Obsidian-compat flat field — equal to sources[0].sha256.

stale_on.description: Obsidian-compat flat field — equal to stale_after.
